definitions.explanation: A state where something necessary is lacking or insufficient.
A flaw or problem with documentation, preparation, or systems.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}に{不備|ふび}があったため、{申請|しんせい}が{却下|きゃっか}された。
examples.english: The application was rejected because the documents were incomplete.

examples.japanese: {設備|せつび}の{不備|ふび}を{指摘|してき}された。
examples.english: The inadequacies in the facilities were pointed out.

examples.japanese: {不備|ふび}がございましたら、ご{連絡|れんらく}ください。
examples.english: Please contact us if there are any deficiencies.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{不|ふ} (not) + {備|び} (preparedness) - literally "not prepared"

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{書類|しょるい}の{不備|ふび} - incomplete documents
・{設備|せつび}の{不備|ふび} - inadequate facilities
・{体制|たいせい}の{不備|ふび} - systemic deficiency
・{不備|ふび}を{補|おぎな}う - to make up for deficiencies

USAGE IN APOLOGIES:
・{不備|ふび}がありましたことをお{詫|わ}び{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます - We apologize for any deficiencies

RELATED:
・{不手際|ふてぎわ} - mishandling (active failure)
・{欠陥|けっかん} - defect, flaw
・{不足|ふそく} - shortage, insufficiency
